rubric.role_summary: Senior in-house employment counsel advising on employee relations, policies, investigations, and employment litigation while contributing to compliance and risk management at a technology company.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior in-house employment counsel advising on employee relations, policies, investigations, and employment litigation while contributing to compliance and risk management at a technology company.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 8+ years of legal experience, including at least 3+ years in-house in tech.
- Employment law experience.
- Experience with employment-related litigation or disputes.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in a high-growth B2B company.
- Prior exposure to regulatory matters or compliance programs.
- Employment law experience covering employee relations, leave administration, pay equity, workplace investigations, performance management and policy development.
- Experience managing or supporting employment-related litigation, pre-litigation disputes and government inquiries, including demand letters, agency charges, subpoenas and litigation holds.
- Project management experience building and scaling programs, including internationally, and leading cross-functional initiatives and change management efforts.
- Understanding of the modern Legal tech stack and surrounding LegalTech ecosystem.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
